item.content:encoded: A Azul (AZUL3.SA) firmou uma operação de financiamento de até R$2 bilhões, com cobertura do risco de crédito concedida pela União, por intermédio da Agência Brasileira Gestora de Fundos Garantidores e Garantias (ABGF), com recursos do Fundo de Garantia à Exportação (FGE), conforme fato relevante da companhia aérea publicado neste sábado. "Os recursos serão destinados exclusivamente ao pagamento de combustível de aviação adquirido para operação regular doméstica", informou a empresa, acrescentando que o financiamento está alinhado à estratégia de longo prazo da companhia e foi contemplado como parte de seu plano de reestruturação. "A operação fortalece ainda mais a posição de liquidez da Azul e proporciona flexibilidade financeira adicional para atuar no atual cenário de volatilidade nos preços dos combustíveis. Somado ao caixa existente e a outras iniciativas de financiamento obtidas recentemente, o montante reforça a confiança da administração na estratégia da companhia e na posição de liquidez da Azul", acrescentou.

item.title: Trump diz que pode mudar equipe de imprensa da Casa Branca de lugar
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local. Em uma publicação nas redes sociais, Trump rejeitou uma reportagem segundo a qual ele planejava remover a sala de imprensa da Casa Branca e restaurar, no local, uma piscina histórica. Ele disse que nunca “sequer pensou em fazer uma coisa tão estúpida”. No entanto, afirmou que poderia realocar o grupo de jornalistas de sua posição atual na Casa Branca. “Posso mudar a Fake News para um local menos desagradável”, escreveu Trump na publicação. O jornal The New York Times informou na terça-feira que Trump havia pedido à então secretária de imprensa Karoline Leavitt, em agosto, que transferisse as entrevistas coletivas para fora da Sala de Imprensa James S. Brady, na Casa Branca, mas a ideia nunca foi colocada em prática. Segundo a reportagem, o presidente disse a assessores que preferiria uma piscina terapêutica coberta, instalada no local durante o governo de Franklin D. Roosevelt. A administração de Nixon substituiu a piscina pela sala de imprensa. Trump tem acusado regularmente a mídia norte-americana de cobertura injusta de seu governo. No mês passado, ele baniu brevemente jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico das dependências da Casa Branca e disse que outros veículos poderiam enfrentar restrições semelhantes. Defensores da liberdade de expressão afirmaram que a medida violou as proteções da Primeira Emenda à liberdade de imprensa. A Casa Branca restabeleceu o acesso desses jornalistas após uma ordem de um juiz federal, que considerou o banimento provavelmente inconstitucional, embora o governo Trump ainda conteste o caso. (Reportagem de Jason Lange em Washington)

item.title: Amgen drug combined with immunotherapy extends survival in lung cancer trial
item.description: Amgen's Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Deena Beasley
item.content:encoded: Amgen's (AMGN.O) Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's (AZN.L) immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday. Imfinzi is currently the standard of care following chemotherapy for patients with this very aggressive and hard-to-treat disease whose cancer does not worsen after initial chemotherapy. The study found that those given both drugs lived for a median of 21.1 months, compared with 12.7 months for those treated only with Imfinzi. "If you give Imdelltra earlier and earlier, you get bigger clinical benefit," said Paul Burton, chief medical officer at California-based Amgen. He called the results "unprecedented in advancing the treatment of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer." Imdelltra's US list price is about $30,000 per cycle, or over $390,000 a year. Wall Street analysts have estimated annual sales reaching more than $2.5 billion by 2030, according to LSEG data. The Amgen drug is currently [USN:L4N3HJ4BN TEXT:"approved for adults"] in the advanced stages of small cell lung cancer that has worsened despite chemotherapy, based on data showing that Imdelltra reduced the risk of death by [USN:L2N3S10O8 TEXT:"40%"]. Full results of the 563-patient trial were presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Amgen had previously announced that the Phase 3 study was [USN:L6N4500PD TEXT:"successful"]. Imdelltra belongs to a dual-target class of drugs called bispecific antibodies designed to pull immune system T cells into contact with cancer cells to destroy them. Imfinzi is an older type of immunotherapy that essentially blocks the mechanism tumors use to hide from immune-system assault. Most lung cancer cases are non-small cell, while up to 15% are the small cell variety targeted by Imdelltra. About 250,000 new cases are diagnosed worldwide each year, according to the US National Institutes of Health. Very few people diagnosed with small cell lung cancer are candidates for surgery, and most are initially given radiotherapy and chemotherapy, Burton said. Survival rates depend on when the cancer is diagnosed, but the overall 5-year rate is only around 9%, according to the American Cancer Society. Amgen said that nearly 80% of trial patients treated with the combination were alive after one year, compared with 53% of those on Imfinzi alone, as patient follow-up continues. Serious side effects, including low white blood cell counts, occurred in 20.9% of patients on the dual therapy and 10.8% with the single therapy. A potentially dangerous condition known as cytokine release syndrome, an aggressive inflammatory response, was reported in 49.6% of patients who received Imdelltra. But only one case was serious and there were no CRS-related deaths. Adverse events led to discontinuation of the combination therapy in 5.7% of trial patients and 5.8% of patients given only Imfinzi. (This story has been corrected to say that median survival for trial patients is 21.1 months vs. 12.7 months, not 21.7 months vs. 12.1 months, in first bullet point.)

item.title: Rei da Jordânia ordena resposta com "mão de ferro" a ataque mortal à igreja
item.description: O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja.
item.dc:creator: Abdelhadi Ramahi
item.content:encoded: O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja. Os agressores dispararam por vários minutos, em plena luz do dia, contra a igreja na província de Karak na sexta-feira, e também feriram 40 pessoas em um ataque raro contra a minoria cristã do país. A segurança foi reforçada em shoppings, embaixadas estrangeiras e outros locais em todo o país, informou a embaixada dos Estados Unidos em Amã. SENSAÇÃO DE PÂNICO Um padre descreveu como ele e outras pessoas mandaram que todos se deitassem no chão na igreja Greco-Ortodoxa São Jorge, a cerca de 120 km a sudoeste da capital, Amã. “Uma sensação de pânico tomou conta das pessoas presentes”, disse Theodoros Soueiss à Reuters. “Os disparos eram indiscriminados, e você nunca sabia onde uma bala poderia parar.” O rei Abdullah condenou o “desprezível ato terrorista” durante uma reunião do Conselho de Segurança Nacional e afirmou que não há espaço para clemência quando se trata da vida dos jordanianos, informou a corte real. Ataques como este são extremamente raros na Jordânia, um país relativamente estável no Oriente Médio, embora as autoridades afirmem ter frustrado vários complôs islamistas nos últimos anos. Não houve reivindicação imediata de responsabilidade pelo ataque no reino, um importante parceiro dos EUA na luta contra grupos militantes. Autoridades disseram ser cedo para determinar se os atacantes tinham vínculos com grupos conhecidos dentro ou fora da Jordânia. “Um massacre, um massacre em todos os sentidos da palavra”, disse Tarek Ammarin em um hospital onde os feridos estavam sendo atendidos. Um parente de Ammarin ficou ferido no ataque. Os cristãos são minoria na população da Jordânia. O país abriga diversos sítios bíblicos que atraem peregrinos cristãos de todo o mundo. A Jordânia está entre os aliados dos EUA no Oriente Médio que foram atingidos por ataques iranianos este ano, após os EUA e Israel lançarem ataques contra o Irã em fevereiro. Bahjat al-Rushda, prefeito da vila de Shihan, em Karak, juntou-se a uma longa lista de autoridades que condenaram o que chamaram de ataque de extremistas terroristas. “Se Deus quiser, este país continuará seguro”, disse ele. (Reportagem de Yasmine Ghania e Eman Abouhassira)

item.title: City boss Maresca rues costly errors as Villa inflict first league defeat
item.description: Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest. City arrived in Birmingham having won all seven of their league matches but a pair of defensive blunders gave Aston Villa their chances and they took both. Marc Guehi's early miscontrol allowed John McGinn to set up Nicolas Jackson for the opening goal, while goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma allowed Jackson's low shot to squirm underneath him after the hour mark. The result was particularly frustrating for City given the balance of play. They registered seven shots on target to Villa's two and repeatedly forced Zion Suzuki into action, but the Japan goalkeeper produced a string of excellent saves to preserve the hosts' lead. There was at least one positive for City with Erling Haaland scoring on his return from a foot injury. The Norwegian had sat out Tuesday's 5-1 Champions League rout of AEK Athens but headed home from Iliman Ndiaye's cross for City's lone goal. The afternoon belonged instead to Suzuki, who continued to justify Villa's faith since they signed him in August to replace the departed Emi Martinez. Time and again he denied City, frustrating Haaland and company as Villa claimed their fourth successive home league victory over the Blues. Maresca was left to lament his side's wastefulness and the two avoidable goals that ultimately decided the match. "Performance overall was good, amount of chances we created. "Absolutely, both (goals were avoidable). Sometimes you have to be a bit more lucky because we only conceded those two chances. But we created a lot of chances. "We played most of the game in their box but you have to be clinical and avoid mistakes like the two goals we conceded." For Villa, after a turbulent summer of arrivals and departures - including Martinez who went to Chelsea - there were finally signs that Unai Emery's rebuilt side are beginning to settle after a poor league start of three losses from their first four games. "Today was a really good test, I was so excited for this test," Emery said. "Today is one step forward." City have little time to dwell on the defeat, with back-to-back meetings against high-flying Brighton & Hove Albion next on the agenda, first in the League Cup fourth round on Wednesday and then in the Premier League next Saturday. "A top team, another one," City defender Ruben Dias said. "A different way to play so we'll make the adaptation then focus on ourselves that's the main thing - our spirit, our will to win."

item.title: Rockets, Hawks vie to remain undefeated in new season
item.description: The Atlanta Hawks will try to start the year with three wins for the first time in six seasons on Saturday night when they face the Houston Rockets in Atlanta's home opener.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Atlanta Hawks will try to start the year with three wins for the first time in six seasons on Saturday night when they face the Houston Rockets in Atlanta's home opener. The Hawks rolled over the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday and will try to go 3-0 for the first time since the 2020-21 team did it and ended up reaching the Eastern Conference final. The Rockets also are undefeated, holding on to beat the San Antonio Spurs 114-110 on Friday. Houston hasn't started with three straight wins since 2017-18, the season the Rockets lost in the Western Conference final. "We're excited," Atlanta's Jalen Johnson said. "We're excited to go play in front of our home crowd. We're looking to come out with the same energy on Saturday." Atlanta has been scoring a lot of points -- an average of 130 in the first two games -- but has flourished because of its defense. Atlanta forced 14 turnovers and limited Charlotte to 43 points in the first half while taking a 68-43 halftime lead. The Hawks finished with 17 steals, created 25 turnovers and wound up setting a club record for the widest margin of victory (47 points). "This game is just giving it to me, I'm not going to lie, I'm throwing it in my hands," said Atlanta's Dyson Daniels, who has 12 steals in two games. "I'm just trying to come out and be the best on defense and have that create our offense, so get out and run." The Hawks have been led by Nickeil Alexander-Walker (an average of 22.5 points a game) and Johnson (19.5 ppg, 10.5 rebounds, seven assists) and newcomer Aaron Wiggins (17.5 ppg). Houston, meanwhile, survived an intense battle on Friday with the rival Spurs. The key play came when 6-foot-7 Amen Thompson blocked 7-foot-4 Victor Wembanyama's potential game-tying drive to the basket with 0.6 seconds remaining. "When Wemby caught the ball, I just thought he was going to be just tall and try to rise over the top -- and that's what he thought," Houston's Kevin Durant said. "But Amen is just a freak athlete. It's insane how he got up so quick to block that shot against the 7-4." The Rockets had three players with 20-plus points against the Spurs: Alperen Sengun with 29, and Durant and Thompson with 20 apiece. Durant has always been a matchup problem for the Hawks. In 34 career games against Atlanta, he is averaging 29.3 points, 6.8 rebounds and 4.7 assists a game. He scored 31 and 25 points against Atlanta last season. "We can look at this and get some film from it and see how we can get better," Durant said. "We've got another game in Atlanta tomorrow, so we can hopefully build on this." The Rockets won both games against the Hawks last season, prevailing by 18 and 22 points in a pair of non-competitive contests. Houston has won four games in a row against the Hawks, including the last two in Atlanta. The team will play again on Monday in Houston to complete the season series. The Rockets plan to rest Fred VanVleet on Saturday. The veteran missed last season with right ACL surgery and will sit out the second night of Houston's back-to-back set because of load management; he played 31 minutes and scored 14 points against the Spurs. Steven Adams (right calf) was able to play almost nine minutes on Friday after being listed as questionable. --Field Level Media

item.title: Couche-Tard proposes up to $8 billion offer for Cumberland Farms, The Times reports
item.description: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard proposed an offer of $7.5 billion to $8 billion for US convenience store operator Cumberland Farms, formerly known as EG Group, Britain's Times newspaper reported on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard (ATD.TO) proposed an offer of $7.5 billion to $8 billion for US convenience store operator Cumberland Farms, formerly known as EG Group, Britain's Times newspaper reported on Saturday. The offer would be lower than Cumberland Farms' $9 billion valuation target for a planned [USN:L4N43419C TEXT:"US IPO"], the report said Couche-Tard and Cumberland Farms did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for a comment Cumberland Farms remained committed to a US listing, the report said, citing people close to the company The report also said Cumberland Farms had delayed its planned IPO after receiving takeover interest, including from infrastructure investor Stonepeak A float is unlikely to take place before 2027 for Cumberland, the Financial Times reported earlier this month, citing people, although the company has not publicly given a timeline Private equity firm TDR Capital owns 50% of Cumberland Farms, while British billionaire entrepreneurs, the Issa brothers, each hold 25%, the Times report said Cumberland Farms operates more than 3,200 convenience stores and fuel stations across the US and Europe

item.title: Agha returns to Pakistan squad for Sri Lanka tests
item.description: Former Pakistan Twenty20 captain Salman Ali Agha, who was among seven players released mid-series after the side lost two tests to England in August, has returned to the test squad for next month's two-match series with Sri Lanka at home, the Pakistan Cricket Board said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Pakistan Twenty20 captain Salman Ali Agha, who was among seven players [USN:L6N44S0YO TEXT:"released mid-series"] after the side lost two tests to England in August, has returned to the test squad for next month's two-match series with Sri Lanka at home, the Pakistan Cricket Board said on Saturday. Agha [USN:L6N45R0XG TEXT:"was removed"] as Pakistan's T20 captain and left out of this month's T20 series against Sri Lanka but the 32-year-old impressed in the One-Day Internationals, scoring a century against Sri Lanka last Sunday. Left-arm spinner Ali Usman, who was also among the players released during the England tour, has been named in the 14-man squad as well, with the first test set to begin on November 9 at Rawalpindi. Babar Azam will continue to lead Pakistan as they look to bounce back from a [USN:L6N45403K TEXT:"3-0 series loss"] in England. However, the hosts have shaken up their batting line-up, calling up Sameer Minhas, Mohammad Taha and Mohammad Suleman for the first time. Shan Masood, who scored a fighting 95 against England in the third test last month, has been dropped. Pakistan squad: Babar Azam (captain), Abdullah Fazal, Ali Usman, Arafat Minhas, Azan Awais, Mohammad Abbas, Mohammad Ghazi Ghori, Mohammad Suleman, Mohammad Taha, Razaullah, Saad Baig, Salman Ali Agha, Sameer Minhas, Saud Shakeel.

item.title: Flávio tem 46,3% e Lula soma 45% em empate técnico na véspera da eleição, diz CNT/MDA
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estão em empate técnico na véspera do segundo turno da eleição presidencial que será realizado no domingo, mostrou pesquisa CNT/MDA divulgada neste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estão em empate técnico na véspera do segundo turno da eleição presidencial que será realizado no domingo, mostrou pesquisa CNT/MDA divulgada neste sábado. Segundo o levantamento, Flávio aparece numericamente à frente com 46,3% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula soma 45,0%. Na pesquisa anterior, divulgada em 16 de outubro, o senador aparecia com 46,8% e o presidente tinha 45,9%. O percentual dos eleitores que declarou voto branco ou nulo é de 5,8%, ante 4,9% na pesquisa anterior, enquanto os indecisos somam 2,9%, ante 2,4%. Pelo critério de votos válidos, que exclui brancos, nulos e indecisos e é usado pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) na totalização dos votos, Flávio soma agora 50,7%, ante 50,5%, enquanto Lula tem 49,3%, ante 49,5%. Como a margem de erro é de 2,2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos, os dois estão em empate técnico a menos de 24 horas da abertura das seções eleitorais no domingo. Para a pesquisa contratada pela Confederação Nacional do Transporte (CNT), o instituto MDA ouviu 2.032 pessoas entre quarta e sexta-feira.

item.title: Protestos na França começam sob forte esquema de segurança
item.description: Manifestantes se reuniram em Paris e em cidades de toda a França neste sábado, sob a vigilância de 70 mil policiais, enquanto o governo tentava evitar a repetição dos distúrbios e saques que sacudiram o país no fim de semana passado.
item.dc:creator: Juliette Jabkhiro, Alessandro Parodi
item.content:encoded: Manifestantes se reuniram em Paris e em cidades de toda a França neste sábado, sob a vigilância de 70 mil policiais, enquanto o governo tentava evitar a repetição dos distúrbios e saques que sacudiram o país no fim de semana passado. O ministro do Interior, Laurent Nuñez, disse que 135 pessoas haviam sido presas em todo o país até o início da tarde, muitas após revistas preventivas que encontraram fogos de artifício, rolamentos de esferas e outros objetos que poderiam ser usados como armas. “Temos que ser extremamente ágeis. Recebemos muitos avisos sobre desordem, tanto de grupos políticos quanto, simplesmente, de criminosos”, disse aos jornalistas. “Vai ser um dia longo.” Enquanto o início da principal marcha em Paris transcorria de forma pacífica, a polícia usou gás lacrimogêneo contra multidões em Lyon, a terceira maior cidade da França. O governo mobilizou 10 mil policiais e gendarmes a mais do que em 17 de outubro, dia em que protestos contra o custo de vida e a deterioração dos serviços públicos se transformaram em alguns dos piores distúrbios que a França viu em anos. LOJAS E MUSEUS FECHADOS Grande parte do centro de Paris parecia uma cidade em lockdown, com lojistas fechando as vitrines com tapumes, museus com as portas fechadas e mais de 20 estações de metrô interditadas. Entidades empresariais pediram que os varejistas permanecessem fechados depois que milhares de lojas e negócios foram danificados ou saqueados em toda a França no fim de semana passado. “Quase não há clientes, então não vale a pena ficar aberto”, disse Oskar, gerente de uma boutique Kiton em Paris. Vários dos mais conhecidos centros culturais da capital, incluindo o Louvre, o Musée d’Orsay e a Ópera de Paris, fecharam como precaução, deixando os turistas frustrados. “Está tudo fechado com tapumes e não sabemos bem para onde ir”, disse Xavier Dolliole, turista da cidade norte-americana de Nova Orleans. A rota da principal manifestação em Paris só foi definida após uma batalha judicial, desencadeada por uma ordem policial de última hora que afastava os organizadores do centro da cidade em direção às regiões do sudeste da capital. A polícia argumentou que o trajeto original passava por áreas com alta concentração de empresas semelhantes às atacadas no fim de semana passado. Líderes de esquerda disseram que a mudança tardia tinha como objetivo causar confusão e afastar as pessoas. “Mais uma vez, os que estão no poder criam transtornos para as marchas e prazos impossíveis para que as organizações se reorganizem”, disse o líder da esquerda radical Jean-Luc Mélenchon, que se juntou aos manifestantes nas ruas de Paris. PARTIDO DE EXTREMA DIREITA REALIZA CONGRESSO Muitos manifestantes acusaram o governo de reagir de forma exagerada, com soldados enviados para patrulhar a Champs-Élysées. “Choramos pelas lojas, não pelas pessoas que são empobrecidas o ano todo”, disse Clara Lebbadi, estudante de artes de 22 anos. “Minha amiga e eu quase não viemos porque estávamos com medo, mas viemos justamente porque é importante não deixar a repressão vencer”, acrescentou. A primeira marcha autorizada neste sábado transcorreu pacificamente em Orléans, a cerca de 120 km ao sul de Paris, onde manifestantes protestaram contra o Reagrupamento Nacional, de Marine Le Pen, que realizava um congresso partidário na cidade. As tensões aumentaram após tiros na sexta-feira a oeste de Paris, quando um atirador, suspeito de agir por ódio islamofóbico, matou uma pessoa e feriu outras quatro, entre elas uma menina de 12 anos. “Viemos dizer à extrema direita, cara a cara, que não temos medo”, disse Bally Bagayoko, prefeito de Saint-Denis e membro do partido de esquerda radical França Insubmissa (LFI). (Reportagem de Crispian Balmer, Bertrand Boucey, Alessandro Parodi, em Paris, e Elizabeth Pineau, em Orléans)

item.title: Adido do USDA prevê safra de soja brasileira de 184 mi t para 2026/27
item.description: Agricultores brasileiros devem colher 184 milhões de toneladas de soja na safra 2026/27, segundo relatório divulgado na quinta-feira pelo adido do Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA, na sigla em inglês) em Brasília.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Agricultores brasileiros devem colher 184 milhões de toneladas de soja na safra 2026/27, segundo relatório divulgado na quinta-feira pelo adido do Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA, na sigla em inglês) em Brasília. A previsão não oficial no relatório do adido, divulgado pelo Serviço Agrícola Estrangeiro do USDA, está abaixo da projeção oficial do USDA para a safra brasileira de soja de 2026/27, de 186 milhões de toneladas. Ainda assim, a previsão do adido representa um aumento de quase 2% em relação a 2025-26, quando o Brasil, maior produtor mundial de soja, produziu uma safra de 180,5 milhões de toneladas. "As chuvas favoráveis no início da temporada têm apoiado o plantio nas principais regiões produtoras, mas a chuva persistente no Rio Grande do Sul e as previsões de tempo severo em vários estados podem prejudicar o desenvolvimento das safras", diz o relatório. Segundo o texto, o adido prevê que as questões climáticas afetarão mais as operações de colheita do que o plantio. "Apesar da expectativa de uma temporada de El Niño no Brasil, os produtores de soja permanecem otimistas, com a maioria das preocupações voltadas para as safras de milho e algodão da segunda temporada", diz o relatório. A análise do adido projetou as exportações brasileiras de soja para 2026/27 em 117,5 milhões de toneladas, um aumento de 2,1% em relação a 2025/26, mas abaixo da previsão oficial do USDA de 118 milhões de toneladas. (Reportagem de Julie Ingwersen em Chicago)

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro, Lula about even ahead of Brazil election runoff, CNT/MDA poll shows
item.description: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva remain about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a CNT/MDA poll showed on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva remain about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a CNT/MDA poll showed on Saturday. The right-wing senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 46.3% of the vote compared with 45% for the leftist Lula, according to the poll. Last week, a poll showed Bolsonaro leading Lula 46.8% to 45.9%. MDA surveyed 2,032 people from October 21 to October 23. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: France Jordan Bardella reconduit à la présidence du Rassemblement national
item.description: Jordan Bardella a été reconduit samedi à la présidence du Rassemblement national, premier parti d'opposition de France, lors d'un congrès à Orléans (Loiret) où des personnalités de gauche ont participé de leur côté à une manifestation hostile à l'extrême droite.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jordan Bardella a été reconduit samedi à la présidence du Rassemblement national, premier parti d'opposition de France, lors d'un congrès à Orléans (Loiret) où des personnalités de gauche ont participé de leur côté à une manifestation hostile à l'extrême droite. "Pour conduire Marine à l'Elysée, j'aurai besoin de vous", a dit devant plusieurs milliers de militants Jordan Bardella, qui s'est félicité d'avoir "multiplié par trois" (160.000) en quatre ans le nombre d'adhérents et il a salué les "70 maires et 3.000 conseillers municipaux" élus au printemps dernier. Unique candidat à sa succession, l'eurodéputé est arrivé en 2022 à la tête du RN, fondé en 1972. Il prononcera dimanche un discours au Zenith d'Orléans, avant une prise de parole de Marine Le Pen, candidate à l'élection présidentielle. Agé de 31 ans, Jordan Bardella est pressenti pour être Premier ministre si Marine Le Pen est élue présidente de la République au printemps prochain, ce que lui prédisent les plus récents sondages d'intentions de vote. Le temps d'un week-end, la ville d'Orléans s'est transformée en symbole d'une France fracturée à six mois de l'échéance. Dans la matinée de samedi, une manifestation réunissant 13.000 personnes - selon la préfecture - à l'appel d'un collectif d'organisations syndicales, associatives et politiques s'est élancée au départ du théâtre d'Orléans, éloigné du Zénith où s'est ouvert le congrès du RN à la mi-journée. "GRANDE INQUIÉTUDE" La secrétaire générale de la CGT, Sophie Binet, le Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste, Olivier Faure, et le maire La France insoumise de Saint-Denis (Seine-Saint-Denis), Bally Bagayoko, ont participé à ce rassemblement sous haute protection policière. "Macron démission, Le Pen en prison", ont scandé les manifestants. "Marianne, jamais Marine", "Le RN c'est la haine au service des ultra riches", pourrait-on lire sur les pancartes du défilé qui s'est déroulé en musique et sans incident. "La montrée de l'extrême droite est une grande inquiétude" a dit à Reuters Benoît Réveillon, retraité orléanais se 63 ans. "Il y a d'autres alternatives. Éveillons nos consciences et proposons autre chose, pacifiquement". Une autre manifestation contestataire prévue dimanche a été interdite par les autorités. De l'autre côté de la Loire, à l'autre bout de la ville quasi déserte où de nombreux magasins avaient protégé leurs vitrines, plusieurs milliers d'élus, adhérents et sympathisants du Rassemblement national ont afflué au Zenith pour le 19e Congrès du RN. "Marine, présidente", a lancé la salle, qui a chanté la Marseillaise et applaudi les forces de l'ordre déployées dans toute la France en cette journée de mobilisation contre la vie chère, notamment. Un drapeau français sur le dos, Samantha Giroux, 39 ans, a dit à Reuters avoir "peur pour ses trois enfants" qu'elle élève à Troyes (Aube). "Maintenant c'est des agressions pour une cigarette", déplore la militante, employée dans la cantine d'un lycée. "Et puis la France aux Français. Soit les étrangers vivent comme nous, si c'est pour foutre le bordel il repartent chez eux". Venue de l'Essonne, Isabelle Fillien, 59 ans, regrette elle aussi "le bordel et l'insurrection partout". À la question de savoir si le RN est en mesure de gagner la présidentielle, elle reste prudente. "On a été déçus aux législatives. Il ne faut pas vendre la peau de l'ours."

item.title: Pelicans, Nuggets limp into first of two meetings in five days
item.description: Playing at high altitude can be hard for visiting teams, and it's even tougher when it's the second game of a back-to-back set.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Playing at high altitude can be hard for visiting teams, and it's even tougher when it's the second game of a back-to-back set. That's what the New Orleans Pelicans will face when they visit the Denver Nuggets on Saturday night. It will be the first of two games the teams will play against each other in the next five days, with the next matchup coming Wednesday in New Orleans. The Pelicans could be without Yves Missi on Saturday after he suffered a left knee injury Friday night at Utah. Missi sustained the injury midway through the second quarter when teammate Zion Williamson landed on the leg following a shot attempt by Williamson. "We're going to get a look at it (Saturday) in Denver," New Orleans coach Jamahl Mosley said of the injury. The Pelicans are coming off a 120-119 loss vs. the Jazz and have to contend with a Nuggets team that lost its season opener at Oklahoma City on Thursday night. Denver scored just 84 points against the Thunder and already is dealing with an injury to the starting lineup. Cam Johnson suffered an ankle injury late in the first half and didn't play in the second on Thursday. He was limping after the game but told The Denver Post he doesn't think it's a serious injury and he won't miss much time -- if any. Without Johnson's ability to stretch defenses from deep, Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray were hounded by Oklahoma City, which held the Nuggets to 37.8% shooting from the field. However, there were bright spots. Aaron Gordon looked strong, rookie Trevon Brazile had 12 rebounds in his NBA debut, and DeMar DeRozan looked comfortable in his first game with Denver. Even if Johnson has to miss the home opener, the Nuggets hope to have Spencer Jones available fairly soon. Jones, who suffered a hamstring strain during the training camp, already has been ruled out for Saturday's game. "It's not a serious thing, just precautionary," Denver coach David Adelman said Thursday night, per The Denver Post. But then he said: "It's one of those injuries that could turn out to be a serious thing." The Pelicans still are looking for the first win for Mosley. New Orleans trailed Utah by 10 at half, outscored the Jazz 38-24 in the third quarter and led by five in the fourth. The Pelicans fell behind by seven and rallied before Dejounte Murray missed a jumper at the buzzer that would have given them the road win. "It's hard to win in this league," Williamson said. "If you want to win, you have to close games." It would help if New Orleans could score more from deep. The Pelicans were 10-for-30 from 3-point range in a season-opening loss to Indiana on Wednesday and followed with an 8-for-26 effort Friday night. Williamson missed his only attempt from deep after going 2-for-4 against the Pacers. He is looking for that shot after attempting only four in 2025-26. "It was a good feeling," Williamson said. "It means a lot to see your work pay off." --Field Level Media

item.title: US veteran Moltzan opens World Cup season with first career win
item.description: Paula Moltzan started the World Cup Alpine ski season with a first career victory at the age of 32 on Saturday after US teammate Mikaela Shiffrin blew a giant slalom first-leg lead and finished seventh in the Austrian resort of Soelden.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paula Moltzan started the World Cup Alpine ski season with a first career victory at the age of 32 on Saturday after US teammate Mikaela Shiffrin blew a giant slalom first-leg lead and finished seventh in the Austrian resort of Soelden. The 2026 Olympic team combined bronze medallist beat Italian-born Lara Colturi, who skis for Albania, by the slimmest of margins - 0.01 of a second after two runs down the Rettenbach glacier slope -- with Germany's Emma Aicher third. The victory from fifth after the first run also made Moltzan the first woman to win with Van Deer skis, the brand founded by Austria's retired eight-times overall World Cup winner Marcel Hirscher. "It feels like a fairytale right now," said the Minnesota-born skier. "It doesn't really feel real but we've put in a lot of hard work this summer developing the ski and it feels like this is kind of a pinnacle, that it's paying off and we did all the right things. I can't imagine a better start." The podium was the 11th of Moltzan's career, six of them second places including one in Soelden a year ago when Austrian [USN:L4N3W602Y TEXT:"Julia Scheib was a first-time winner."] Scheib did not finish the first run this time. World Cup overall champion Shiffrin led by 0.14 seconds after the first run, with Sweden's Sara Hector second and Switzerland's Camille Rast third, but conditions changed for the later starters in the second leg with falling snow, flat light and grey skies. The 31-year-old US great, chasing a record-extending 111th World Cup win, has not won a giant slalom since December 2023 but has [USN:L8N45S1IB TEXT:"shifted her focus"] this season towards that discipline and super-G, and will race fewer slaloms. Saturday's race also marked the World Cup return of Slovakian Petra Vlhova, who had been out injured since January 2024. The 2022 Olympic slalom champion and 2021 overall World Cup winner finished 23rd. Italian Federica Brignone, the [USN:L8N3ZB04X TEXT:"Olympic champion"] in giant slalom and super-G on home snow in Cortina in February, was absent as she continues her recovery from surgery in August.

SOELDEN, Austria, Oct 24 : Paula Moltzan started the World Cup Alpine ski season with a first career victory at the age of 32 on Saturday after US teammate Mikaela Shiffrin blew a giant slalom first-leg lead and finished seventh in the Austrian resort of Soelden. The 2026 Olympic team combined bronze medallist beat Italian-born Lara Colturi, who skis for Albania, by the slimmest of margins - 0.01 of a second after two runs down the Rettenbach glacier slope - with Germany's Emma Aicher third. The victory from fifth after the first run also made Moltzan the first woman to win with Van Deer skis, the brand founded by Austria's retired eight-times overall World Cup winner Marcel Hirscher. "It feels like a fairytale right now," said the Minnesota-born skier.

"It doesn't really feel real but we've put in a lot of hard work this summer developing the ski and it feels like this is kind of a pinnacle, that it's paying off and we did all the right things. I can't imagine a better start." The podium was the 11th of Moltzan's career, six of them second places including one in Soelden a year ago when Austrian Julia Scheib was a first-time winner. Scheib did not finish the first run this time. World Cup overall champion Shiffrin led by 0.14 seconds after the first run, with Sweden's Sara Hector second and Switzerland's Camille Rast third, but conditions changed for the later starters in the second leg with falling snow, flat light and grey skies. The 31-year-old US great, chasing a record-extending 111th World Cup win, has not won a giant slalom since December 2023 but has shifted her focus this season towards that discipline and super-G, and will race fewer slaloms. Saturday's race also marked the World Cup return of Slovakian Petra Vlhova, who had been out injured since January 2024. The 2022 Olympic slalom champion and 2021 overall World Cup winner finished 23rd.     Italian Federica Brignone, the Olympic champion in giant slalom and super-G on home snow in Cortina in February, was absent as she continues her recovery from surgery in August.

item.title: China urges US to halt proposed expansion of outbound investment curbs
item.description: The Chinese commerce ministry urged the United States on Saturday to stop expanding restrictions on American investments in China, saying a proposed rule on sensitive technologies would disrupt trade ties.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: The Chinese commerce ministry urged the United States on Saturday to stop expanding restrictions on American investments in China, saying a proposed rule on sensitive technologies would disrupt trade ties. The US Treasury Department [USN:L1N46814W TEXT:"issued proposals"] on Thursday to update its outbound-investment security programme, adding biotechnology to restricted sectors and expanding coverage of high-performance computing and hypersonic systems. Beijing's commerce ministry said in a statement that the proposal "discriminatorily" widened China-related investment restrictions and intensified curbs. It firmly opposed the US proposal and reserved the right to take unspecified countermeasures, it added. Beijing also said the proposal would damage bilateral economic ties and ran counter to the consensus reached by the countries' presidents, who have [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"met twice"] in the past six months. The US Treasury has said the measures, which do not only cover China, are intended to stop US capital from supporting foreign adversaries' development of dual-use strategic technologies that could threaten US national security. The US programme had already restricted certain US investments involving China in semiconductors, quantum technologies and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Train hits minibus in Russia's Far East, killing six
item.description: Six people were killed and one person was injured when a train collided with a minibus in Russia's Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, local railway authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six people were killed and one person was injured when a train collided with a minibus in Russia's Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, local railway authorities said. According to railway officials, the minibus attempted to cross the tracks at a level crossing despite a red signal and was struck by a passenger train bound for the city of Blagoveshchensk. All the victims were in the minibus. The train's passengers and crew were not hurt. The state-run RIA news agency, citing regional prosecutors, reported that all the minibus occupants were foreign nationals, but did not specify their nationalities.

item.title: Arsenal join Man City at summit after Villa end leaders' perfect start
item.description: City remain top with 21 points, but the loss opens the door for Arsenal to draw level later in the day.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Arsenal joined Manchester City at the top of the Premier League table after a 2-0 victory over Everton in torrential rain at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday, capitalising on City's first defeat of the season earlier in the day. City had left the door open when they fell to a 2-1 loss at Aston Villa, where Nicolas Jackson struck twice to end the visitors' perfect start to the league campaign. Tottenham Hotspur stunned fourth-placed Chelsea 2-0 in only their second league victory at Stamford Bridge in 36 years, while Fulham beat Coventry City 1-0 for their second league victory of the season. With the leaders beaten in Birmingham, Arsenal seized their chance to erase the three-point gap as goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel secured a comfortable win over Everton in soaking north London conditions. The result moved Mikel Arteta's side level on 21 points with City in what is already shaping up to be a closely fought title race after eight games, but one played under a cloud amid City's off-field financial case. STRONG START Arsenal made their strong start count when Martin Odegaard's corner caused chaos in the Everton box. England goalkeeper Jordan Pickford kept out the initial danger after the ball was flicked on at the near post but, with Everton unable to clear, Konsa bundled home his first goal for the club from a yard out in the seventh minute. The set-piece goal was Arsenal's first since May, ending a run of 13 games across all competitions without one. "I've come to this stadium for many seasons, I know how tough it is to play against us," Konsa said. "It's not surprising to me. "We are champions and to be champions you've got to win games consistently. This is our home and we want to win as many games here as possible." Arsenal's two milestone men combined to give the Gunners a two-goal cushion in the 68th minute, with Ben White marking his 200th appearance for the club by clipping a cross to the far post, where Gabriel headed home on his 200th Premier League appearance. Everton are ninth in the table. JACKSON DOUBLE At Villa Park, Unai Emery's team climbed to sixth on 11 points with their first home league victory this season and third successive league win over City, who are playing under the shadow of an independent commission's findings that they committed 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules. City have always denied any wrongdoing, and have appealed. Jackson took advantage of two City blunders, opening the scoring in the sixth minute when defender Marc Guehi's heavy touch allowed Villa captain John McGinn to pounce and feed the striker, who slotted the ball into the bottom corner. Erling Haaland equalised soon after the break when he headed home Iliman Ndiaye's clipped cross from a free kick. But Jackson struck the winner on the hour when Ibrahim Mbaye surged down the right before cutting the ball back for his Senegal international teammate, whose shot sneaked under the diving body of keeper Gianluigi Donnarumma. "It was incredible, we got the win which is the most important thing. Man City are a strong team, the league leaders," Jackson told TNT Sports. "It's just the beginning, we're trying to work game by game." At Stamford Bridge, Spurs got on the scoresheet in the 77th minute when Chelsea goalkeeper Mike Penders punched a corner into his own net in his first league start. Chelsea were reduced to 10 men when Cole Palmer was shown a second yellow card in the 80th minute for a late challenge on Conor Gallagher. Mathys Tel sealed the victory for Spurs in the 87th when he gained possession inside his own half before embarking on a surging run down the left, gliding past two defenders and firing a low shot from outside the box into the bottom corner. "It's very special, because we came here a lot of times and didn't get a win," said Tel. "And today, we made it together, all together, we showed great mentality, and I'm very happy about it." Spurs climbed to 12th with the win. At Coventry, Fulham appeared ready to substitute Oscar Bobb before the winger produced a moment of quality in the 80th minute, driving into the box and curling a superb finish into the far corner. Fulham are 13th in the table, while Coventry are 19th.

item.title: ウクライナでスターリンク復旧、利用制限で軍事作戦に支障 「規約違反」とマスク氏
item.description: [キーウ（キエフ） ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ（キエフ） ２４日 ロイター] - ウクライナは２４日、米スペースＸの衛星通信網「スターリンク」と軍事向け通信サービス「スターシールド」が全面復旧したと発表した。１週間以上にわたる利用制限はロシアとの軍事作戦に支障を来し、米国との緊張を高めていた。

イーロン・マスク氏が経営する宇宙開発企業スペースＸが提供する両システムの利用制限は、トランプ米大統領がウクライナ政府にロシアの製油所への攻撃停止を迫る一方、ロシアからディーゼル燃料を購入する合意を発表した後に発生した。

ウクライナ当局者によると、利用制限によってロシアの攻撃ドローンを迎撃する能力が損なわれ、一部の作戦が中止を余儀なくされた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は通信アプリのテレグラムに、「スターリンクとスターシールドが制限前の速度で再び利用できるようになった。われわれが必要とする速度で使えるようになった」と投稿した。

マスク氏はその数時間後、ウクライナ軍がスターリンクの利用規約に違反したと非難した。「ウクライナ軍はスターリンクの利用規約に違反し、人を殺傷する攻撃的な無人機（ドローン）攻撃に使用した。その抜け穴は先週塞がれた」とXに投稿した。

製油所を含むロシア領内への長距離ドローン攻撃はどちらの通信システムにも依存していないが、ウクライナ軍にとってスターリンクは引き続き前線での通信に不可欠だ。また、スターシールドを使った中距離攻撃用ドローンは、ウクライナが２０２６年に複数の戦場で優位に立つ上で欠かせない役割を果たしてきた。

トランプ米政権は、ウクライナにおけるスターリンクやスターシールドの利用制限について責任を認めていないが、ロイターはスターシールドの利用を制限する指示がホワイトハウスから出ていたと報じている。関係筋によると、歴代米政権はこれまでも、さまざまな国でスターリンクのサービスを有効化または停止するようスペースＸに複数回要請していた。

トランプ氏は２３日、サービスは完全に復旧したとするそれまでの発言とは異なり、問題が続いているのであれば「解決させる」と述べた。

item.title: Manifestaciones se tornan violentas en París tras marchas pacíficas en resto de Francia
item.description: Cientos de miles de personas se manifestaron el sábado en Francia, en concentraciones mayormente pacíficas que dieron paso a enfrentamientos en París y Marsella al caer la noche, a pesar de un enorme dispositivo de seguridad destinado a evitar que se repitieran los disturbios de la semana pasada.
item.dc:creator: Juliette Jabkhiro, Alessandro Parodi
item.content:encoded: Cientos de miles de personas se manifestaron el sábado en Francia, en concentraciones mayormente pacíficas que dieron paso a enfrentamientos en París y Marsella al caer la noche, a pesar de un enorme dispositivo de seguridad destinado a evitar que se repitieran los disturbios de la semana pasada. El Ministerio del Interior afirmó que 410.000 personas participaron en las protestas en todo el país, aunque los sindicatos señalaron que la cifra real era del doble. La marcha principal tuvo lugar en París, donde unas 110.000 personas se manifestaron en la periferia sureste de la capital, denunciando el aumento del coste de la vida y la creciente desigualdad. El ambiente se deterioró drásticamente tras el fin de la manifestación. La policía antidisturbios lanzó gases lacrimógenos y utilizó cañones de agua para dispersar a unos 500 jóvenes encapuchados que lanzaban piedras a los agentes, informó un responsable de seguridad. En Marsella, la segunda ciudad más grande de Francia, unos jóvenes arrastraron grandes láminas de metal para bloquear una calle, incendiaron contenedores de basura y lanzaron piedras y botellas contra la policía antidisturbios. Los enfrentamientos continuaron tras la puesta de sol y la policía informó que dos joyerías habían sido asaltadas. También se produjeron enfrentamientos en Lyon, Burdeos y Grenoble, mientras que la policía lanzó gas lacrimógeno contra los manifestantes en Clermont-Ferrand, Lille, Nantes y Niza. No obstante, la violencia fue menos intensa que hace una semana, cuando saqueadores y vándalos causaron estragos en varias ciudades. Las autoridades desplegaron 70.000 agentes de policía y gendarmes, 10.000 más que una semana antes, tras reconocer que habían subestimado la magnitud de los disturbios del 17 de octubre. "Tenemos que ser ultra reactivos", declaró el sábado a periodistas el ministro del Interior, Laurent Núñez, acusando a activistas de extrema izquierda y a bandas criminales de intentar fomentar la violencia. Gran parte del centro de París adquirió el aspecto de una ciudad sitiada, con los comerciantes tapiando escaparates, los museos cerrados y más de 20 estaciones de metro inactivas. "Apenas hay clientes, así que no merece la pena mantener abierto", afirmó Oskar, gerente de una boutique de Kiton en París. Varias de las instituciones culturales más conocidas de la capital, entre ellas el Louvre, el Museo de Orsay y la Ópera de París, cerraron durante todo el día como medida de precaución, lo que dejó a los turistas frustrados. "Todo está tapiado y no sabemos muy bien dónde deberíamos estar", comentó Xavier Dolliole, un turista de la ciudad estadounidense de Nueva Orleans. PROTESTAS SE EXTIENDEN Los disturbios a escala nacional comenzaron el mes pasado con pequeñas manifestaciones estudiantiles en los suburbios de París para denunciar las condiciones en los centros educativos. Tras extenderse a una protesta más amplia contra la situación económica en Francia, también impulsaron a los manifestantes a salir a las calles en los países vecinos. El sábado, la policía belga utilizó gas lacrimógeno y spray de pimienta durante los enfrentamientos en Bruselas con manifestantes antigubernamentales, mientras que en varias ciudades italianas se celebraron protestas por segundo fin de semana consecutivo. El recorrido de la principal manifestación de París no se fijó hasta después de una batalla legal desencadenada por una orden policial de última hora que obligó a los organizadores a alejarse del centro de la ciudad hacia la periferia sureste de la capital. La policía argumentó que el recorrido original atravesaba zonas con una alta concentración de comercios similares a los que fueron objeto de ataques el pasado fin de semana. Los líderes de izquierda afirmaron que el cambio de última hora tenía como objetivo sembrar la confusión y alejar a la gente. "Una vez más, quienes ostentan el poder están creando obstáculos para las marchas e imponiendo plazos imposibles para que la gente se reorganice", afirmó el líder de la extrema izquierda Jean-Luc Mélenchon, que se unió a la multitud en las calles de París. Tras elogiar lo que calificó de "magnífica muestra masiva de disciplina colectiva y autocontrol", Mélenchon predijo que las protestas continuarían hasta que el presidente Emmanuel Macron, cuyo mandato expira el año que viene, abordara el malestar social. Francia es una de las naciones más ricas del mundo pero afronta una deuda cada vez mayor que ha alarmado a los inversionistas. "Dada la situación actual, creo que acabará comprendiendo que esto volverá a ocurrir cada semana. Todavía hay tiempo para que (Macron) ceda. Después de eso, lo único que le quedará será la puerta de salida", declaró Mélenchon a periodistas. La primera marcha autorizada del sábado transcurrió pacíficamente en Orléans, a unos 120 km al sur de París, donde los manifestantes se concentraron contra el partido de extrema derecha Agrupación Nacional, de Marine Le Pen, que celebraba su congreso en la ciudad. Las tensiones se agudizaron tras un tiroteo ocurrido el viernes al oeste de París, en el que un hombre armado —del que se sospecha que actuó movido por el odio islamófobo— mató a una persona e hirió a otras cuatro, entre ellas una niña de 12 años. "Hemos venido a decirle a la extrema derecha, cara a cara, que no tenemos miedo", afirmó Bally Bagayoko, alcalde de Saint-Denis y miembro del partido de extrema izquierda "Francia Inquebrantable".

item.title: La Mona Lisa queda fuera del alcance del público tras cierre de museos París por temor a las protestas
item.description: Los decepcionados turistas asomaban la cabeza el sábado por las puertas cerradas del Louvre y se lamentaban que no podrían ver a la Mona Lisa, en una jornada en que las galerías y los museos de todo París cerraron como medida de precaución ante las nuevas manifestaciones.
item.dc:creator: Sybille de La Hamaide
item.content:encoded: Los decepcionados turistas asomaban la cabeza el sábado por las puertas cerradas del Louvre y se lamentaban que no podrían ver a la Mona Lisa, en una jornada en que las galerías y los museos de todo París cerraron como medida de precaución ante las nuevas manifestaciones. "Cuando llegamos, pensamos que podría haber algún problema, pero no que el museo estuviera cerrado", dijo la italiana Selena Bertoni, de 31 años, frente al Museo de Orsay. Los cierres se produjeron una semana después de que las manifestaciones a nivel nacional por el costo de vida y el deterioro de los servicios públicos degeneraran en algunos de los peores episodios de violencia callejera que ha vivido Francia en años. La violencia y los daños llevaron al Gobierno a imponer toques de queda localizados y a cerrar muchos lugares públicos antes de las manifestaciones previstas para el sábado. El cierre se extendió a gran parte del sector cultural de la capital, incluidos los museos de la Orangerie, el Jeu de Paume y el Picasso, mientras que todo el complejo de los Jardines de las Tullerías, que da al Louvre, quedó acordonado. "Este es el tercer museo al que llegamos y que está cerrado. Deberían habernos avisado", comentó la francesa Heidi Rosar, de 21 años. En el Louvre, las puertas de hierro negro cerradas con llave bloqueaban el acceso a todo el recinto y al jardín. "Queríamos ver al menos la pirámide", comentó Don Nowschuk, un canadiense de 67 años, refiriéndose a la emblemática entrada acristalada del museo. Nowschuk sugirió que las autoridades locales podrían estar exagerando. "Hay tanta seguridad que uno pensaría que sería suficiente para proteger el museo (...) Es un poco extraño ver tantos policías armados por todo París. Estamos acostumbrados a las armas, pero no así". Las restricciones se extendieron al sector de las artes escénicas. La Ópera de París cerró tanto el Palais Garnier como la Ópera de la Bastilla, alegando motivos de seguridad para el personal y el público.

item.title: Ucrania afirma que Starlink ha vuelto a la normalidad tras una semana de restricciones
item.description: Ucrania afirmó el sábado que el sistema de satélites Starlink y su versión militar, Starshield, volvían a funcionar a altas velocidades tras más de una semana de restricciones que habían entorpecido las operaciones militares y agravado las tensiones con Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ucrania afirmó el sábado que el sistema de satélites Starlink y su versión militar, Starshield, volvían a funcionar a altas velocidades tras más de una semana de restricciones que habían entorpecido las operaciones militares y agravado las tensiones con Estados Unidos. Los problemas con los sistemas propiedad de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, se produjeron después de que el presidente Donald Trump anunciara un acuerdo para comprar gasóleo ruso, al tiempo que presionaba a Kiev para que dejara de atacar las refinerías de petróleo de Moscú. Las autoridades ucranianas afirmaron que las restricciones dificultaron la capacidad del ejército para interceptar drones de ataque rusos y obligaron a cancelar algunas operaciones. "Lo más importante hoy es que Starlink y Starshield han reanudado sus operaciones a las velocidades que tenían antes de las restricciones. Las velocidades se sitúan ahora en el nivel que necesitamos", declaró el presidente Volodimir Zelenski en la aplicación Telegram. Según Zelenski, las velocidades comenzaron a volver a la normalidad durante la noche. El Ministerio de Defensa de Ucrania afirmó el sábado que la conexión se mantenía estable a más de 400 km/h. Mientras estaban vigentes las limitaciones, Ucrania experimentó problemas al intentar operar a velocidades superiores a los 160 km/h. Ucrania no depende de estos sistemas para las operaciones con drones de largo alcance en territorio ruso, pero Starlink es vital para las comunicaciones en primera línea y Starshield se utiliza para operaciones militares en los territorios ocupados. Ni Musk ni Washington han reconocido su responsabilidad en la restricción de Starlink o Starshield en Ucrania. Ambos han declarado públicamente que cualquier decisión de este tipo solo podría haberla tomado la otra parte. Reuters informó que la orden de limitar Starshield procedía del interior de la Casa Blanca. Anteriormente, los gobiernos de Estados Unidos habían pedido en varias ocasiones a SpaceX que activara o desactivara Starlink en distintos países, indicaron las fuentes. Trump declaró el viernes que, si los problemas persistían, "lo solucionaría".

item.title: Around 1,200 Palestinians are displaced in Hebron as Israel begins military operation
item.description: About 1,200 Palestinians were displaced as the military began an operation in the West Bank a day after a Palestinian attack killed two Israeli soldiers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Israeli military forced around 1,200 Palestinians to leave their homes in Hebron in the occupied West Bank, a Palestinian official said on Saturday, a day after a Palestinian attack [USN:L1N4690KO TEXT:"killed two Israeli"] soldiers. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday had said the military would launch a large-scale operation after the soldiers were killed when two Palestinian gunmen opened fire at a military checkpoint near the city. The Israeli military said the gunmen were shot dead. They also said the operation in the Al-Jaladah and Ein Deir Baha neighbourhoods near the military checkpoint at the entrance of Hebron was to search for militants and weapons. In a statement, it also said the military would carry out demolitions. The Palestinian Authority criticised the operation as a "collective punishment". Yousef Zouhair Al-Jabari, the head of Hebron's municipality, said around 1,300 faced losing their homes in addition to the 1,200 already displaced. He also said the Israeli operations were motivated by parliamentary elections on Tuesday when Netanyahu's right-wing coalition may lose his majority, opinion polls show. "Netanyahu and the radical ministers in his government are trying to win as many votes as possible from the settlers," Al-Jabari said. The non-governmental organisation the Palestinian Prisoners' Club said Israeli forces had arrested around 70 Palestinians on Friday and Saturday. Israeli officials have not commented on any arrests. NETANYAHU'S GOVERNMENT HAS PRESIDED OVER EXPANSION OF SETTLEMENTS Al-Jabari said the military had demolished shops, factories, homes, and roads in Hebron and that the response was disproportionate and unjustified. Residents in Hebron told Reuters that the military expelled many people with no connection to the Palestinian attackers. "We are calling on officials to stand by us because we are not involved in any of this. There are children. We are isolated; we don’t do anything. This is all arbitrary,” said Majdi Nasser, one of those driven from his home. Residents told Reuters they saw Israeli soldiers marking homes with a black X after their Palestinian occupants had been forced to leave. It was not immediately clear what the X mark meant. Netanyahu's government has presided over a rapid [USN:L6N44Y077 TEXT:"expansion"] of settlements, deemed illegal by UN bodies and most countries, though Israel disputes this. Across the West Bank, Israel has blocked the entrances to most Palestinian cities and towns, severely curtailing Palestinians' freedom of movement. Yousef Mur, a resident of the Palestinian town of Yatta, said the closures meant he was unable to reach Jerusalem with his daughter for her cancer treatment. "The situation is bad, and we are suffering. When we tried to cross, they fired stun grenades towards us, and my girl got scared on the way. They fired stun grenades towards people. The situation is very difficult," Mur said. (This story has been refiled to remove the repeated word 'when' in paragraph 2.)

item.title: Infantino laughs off resignation talk, touts global support as he seeks reelection
item.description: Gianni Infantino finds himself in a position of strength three months after facing calls to resign.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: FIFA president Gianni Infantino laughed off questions about whether he had considered resigning in the wake of the failed FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, pointing to overwhelming support from member associations around the globe. Three months after facing calls to resign after he abandoned the proposal that sought private investment in a new entity controlling commercial rights linked to major FIFA competitions, Infantino now finds himself in a position of strength. His prospects for reelection strengthened on Friday after the [USN:L1N46902J TEXT:"head of Asian football endorsed him"] for a fourth term, with Asian Football confederation (AFC) President Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa saying Asia was united behind Infantino. "I was elected by 211 member associations from all over the world. I think what is important is that in an organisation like FIFA, there can be different views, different points of view," Infantino told the BBC as he laughed off a question about whether he had considered stepping down. "But if we are serious about democracy, about the democratic process, about believing that everyone has the same vote and the same voice all over the world, that football belongs to everyone ... then we need to respect as well the views of the vast, vast majority. "I'm just coming back off Tokyo where the Asian Football Confederation has fully endorsed me. I was in Cape Verde where all African countries have endorsed me. I'm speaking to all associations everywhere in the world." The AFC had previously joined European body UEFA and CONCACAF, which represents North and Central America and the Caribbean, in [USN:L6N4470F3 TEXT:"criticising the FFE proposal"]. But a divided CONCACAF and the AFC's U-turn have left [USN:L4N4691GK TEXT:"Europe increasingly isolated"] while exposing the lack of a viable alternative candidate for the FIFA presidency. Infantino is seeking a fourth term until 2031 and potential candidates must submit their nominations by November 18. He apologised at a FIFA Council meeting in Zurich last week over the way the FFE proposal was handled but that did not sway [USN:L8N4611Y3 TEXT:"European football associations"] such as Germany and England. However, the 56-year-old Swiss-Italian administrator added: "It's OK to disagree ... but then we need to be able to move on. "There are different points of view. It's not always easy to bring them all under one roof, but we need to respect and I do respect all opinions all views," Infantino added. "Then it will be up to the FIFA member associations to decide who they want as a president and how they want FIFA to be run."

item.title: Rey Jordania ordena responder con "mano de hierro" a atentado contra iglesia que dejó ocho muertos
item.description: El rey Abdalá de Jordania ordenó el sábado a las fuerzas de seguridad que respondieran con "mano de hierro", mientras las autoridades buscaban a los hombres armados que abrieron fuego y mataron a nueve personas e hirieron a otras 40 durante un funeral celebrado en una iglesia.
item.dc:creator: Abdelhadi Ramahi
item.content:encoded: El rey Abdalá de Jordania ordenó el sábado a las fuerzas de seguridad que respondieran con "mano de hierro", mientras las autoridades buscaban a los hombres armados que abrieron fuego y mataron a nueve personas e hirieron a otras 40 durante un funeral celebrado en una iglesia. Los agresores dispararon durante varios minutos a plena luz del día el viernes, durante un funeral celebrado en una iglesia ortodoxa griega de la provincia de Karak, en lo que las autoridades jordanas calificaron de acto de terrorismo extremista. No hubo ninguna reivindicación inmediata de la autoría del inusual ataque contra la minoría cristiana de Jordania. Se reforzó la seguridad en centros comerciales, embajadas extranjeras y otros lugares de todo el país, informó la embajada de Estados Unidos en Amán. Un sacerdote describió cómo él y otras personas ordenaron a los asistentes que se tiraran al suelo en la iglesia ortodoxa griega de San Jorge, situada a unos 120 km al suroeste de Amán. "Se apoderó de los presentes una sensación de pánico", declaró Theodoros Soueiss a Reuters. "Los disparos eran indiscriminados y nunca se sabía dónde podría impactar una bala". El rey Abdalá condenó el "despreciable acto terrorista" mientras presidía una reunión del Consejo de Seguridad Nacional y afirmó que no había lugar para la indulgencia cuando se trata de la vida de los jordanos, informó la Casa Real. Este tipo de atentados son muy poco habituales en Jordania, un Estado relativamente estable en Oriente Medio, aunque las autoridades afirman haber desbaratado varios complots islamistas en los últimos años. Las autoridades indicaron que seguían buscando a los autores del atentado y añadieron que era demasiado pronto para determinar si tenían vínculos con grupos conocidos dentro o fuera de Jordania. "Una masacre en todos los sentidos de la palabra", declaró Tarek Ammarin en un hospital donde se atendía a los heridos. Un familiar de Ammarin resultó herido en el atentado. Las imágenes de video de Reuters mostraban a la policía patrullando el sábado frente a la iglesia de Hamoud, a unos 120 km al suroeste de la capital, Amán. "Esto es consecuencia de una ideología terrorista y de un extremismo ciego, y no permitiremos que la sociedad siga por este camino", declaró el primer ministro Jafar Hassan en una publicación en X. Los cristianos constituyen una minoría de la población jordana. El país alberga varios lugares bíblicos que atraen a peregrinos cristianos de todo el mundo.

Oct 24 (Reuters) – Several industrial facilities were damaged in a drone attack on the Russian city of Togliatti on Saturday, local authorities said, while Ukraine said it had struck a major petrochemical plant there.

Togliatti mayor Ilya Sukhikh said preliminary reports indicated no fatalities or injuries. He did not specify which facilities had been hit.

Ukraine’s General Staff said it had struck the Togliattikauchuk petrochemical plant, one of Russia’s largest producers of synthetic rubber.

Show Full Article

The General Staff also reported a strike on the Proton electronics plant in Russia’s Oryol region, which Kyiv says manufactures components for cruise and ballistic missiles.

Oryol regional governor Andrei Klychkov said three people were killed on Friday in a Ukrainian missile strike on an unspecified civilian facility in the region.

Ukraine’s military also reported hitting an aircraft at the Yeysk airfield in southern Russia. Local authorities confirmed an attack in the area but said it caused only minor damage to two apartment buildings.

Russia’s Defence Ministry said on Saturday that air defences had destroyed 1,297 drones, one French-made SCALP cruise missile and four Ukrainian Neptune missiles over the previous 24 hours.

(Reporting by ReutersEditing by Ros Russell and Mark Potter)
